pages.title: Business context
pages.body: A sales team needs a customer/product revenue report. Work with the supplied small Sales, DimCustomer and DimProduct teaching model, not a real Power BI service.

pages.title: Tables and grain
pages.body: Sales contains order lines; OrderKey may repeat. CustomerKey and ProductKey link dimension members to facts. A line-level Sales key is distinct from an order key.

pages.title: KPI and filter rules
pages.body: Revenue is the sum of line Quantity times UnitPrice. Country/category filters should propagate over valid active dimension-to-fact paths. Reference output is not a learner result.

pages.title: Observed symptom
pages.body: A country slicer no longer changes the measure after a relationship is deactivated. Explain the relationship path before changing the calculation.

pages.title: Overview
pages.body: You are preparing a customer-level report. Keep customers with no paid orders. Each task is an independent interview drill using its referenced exercise fixture.

pages.title: Data dictionary
pages.body: customers has one row per customer_id. orders has one row per order_id, with customer_id, order_date, amount and status. Inspect actual small fixture rows from the active task; do not assume monetary units.

rows: Status filtering and tied order dates

pages.title: Business rules
pages.body: Revenue includes paid orders only. Latest order is selected by order_date descending, then order_id descending. Duplicate dates do not define a deterministic order by themselves.

pages.title: Quality exhibits
pages.body: Test empty orders, customers with no matches and repeated dates. A passing base fixture is insufficient when a tie fixture fails.

pages.title: Existing system
pages.body: A daily teaching pipeline extracts orders, transforms them, validates quality and publishes a mart. Review dependencies before assuming the run is safe.

pages.title: Source and watermark
pages.body: A source watermark restricts extraction; it is not a destination deduplication key. Update it only after successful data handling. No real destination transaction is simulated.

pages.title: Operational requirements
pages.body: Publication must not bypass validation. Failure and retry behavior must be explicit. A join after an intentional branch skip needs a compatible trigger rule.

pages.title: Run evidence
pages.body: Use the active task's synthetic logs/grid. Do not attribute old run logs to a newly edited graph. Inspect the failing task and its downstream states.

pages.title: Incident brief
pages.body: An application update combines a feature branch and changes a data-worker deployment. Investigate each independent supplied artifact; there is no live Git remote or Kubernetes cluster.

pages.title: Git exhibit
pages.body: The feature and main branches diverged. Preserve both lines of work when integrating the change. Graph predictions must not mutate HEAD or refs.

pages.title: Deployment exhibit
pages.body: A Service has no matching endpoints. Compare its selector with the Pod template labels using the active task fixture. A green text check is not a real cluster validation.

pages.title: Resource exhibit
pages.body: A worker was OOMKilled. Distinguish supplied memory-limit evidence from an actual profiler result. Record what additional observations you would collect.
